Products about solutions products news certification close About Solutions Products News Certification Customer Portal Contact customer portal contact menu ExR-2.5 Robotics built for real-world deployment The ExR-2.5 integrates into existing facilities with minimal operational disruption, allowing teams to start autonomous inspections faster. Designed for ATEX, IECEx Zone 1 and UL-listed hazardous environments, the ExR-2.5 delivers repeatable inspections while collecting high-quality visual, thermal, acoustic and environmental data. 60+ Robots Deployed 40 Industrial Sites 7+ Global Regions ATEX / IECEx Zone 1 Certified Benefits Modern inspection challenges demand safer, more efficient ways to gather reliable data. Improve Safety Reduce human exposure in hazardous areas. Reliable Insights Collect repeatable inspection data that supports informed maintenance decisions. Reduce Downtime Detect defects before they become costly failures. Increase Productivity Allow experienced personnel to focus on higher-value work. Engineered for  hazardous environments ATEX, IECEx Zone 1 certified & UL-listed Fully autonomous missions Autonomous docking & charging High-quality inspection data Multiple configurations available Rugged all-weather design 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 Explore the ExR-2.5 features specification 1 Antennas 2 Drive module 3 Battery pack 4 Microphone 5 Communication module 6 LiDAR localisation & collision avoidance 7 Drive camera 8 MFPTZ 9 Sensor Payload certification ATEX, IECEx Zone 1 & UL-certified Temperature -40°C to +55°C Coverage per charge Up to 2km Mission duration 2-6 hours Charging Zone 1 autonomous charging Weather Designed for outdoor industrial environments Connectivity 4G/5G Additional features The ExR-2.5 can be configured with a range of additional modules and sensors to match your operational needs. Customers can select the capabilities required for their environment, from enhanced inspection and communication to advanced monitoring. Available options include: Enhanced inspection: PTZ cameras, acoustic cameras, thermal imaging, LED lighting, and inspection modules Gas detection: Integrated sensors for monitoring gases such as methane (CH₄), hydrogen sulphide (H₂S), hydrogen (H₂), and VOCs Communication: Optional microphone for remote interaction Additional integration: Options such as remote pipe thickness monitoring and other expansion modules. Our team can help configure the right ExR-2.5 setup based on your inspection requirements and operational environment. let's talk Ready to deploy Whether you're deploying to a refinery, offshore platform or chemical plant, the ExR-2.5 is designed to move safely between sites. Custom-engineered transport cases Robust protection during shipping Fast unloading and deployment Compact system for straightforward site logistics Ideal for permanent and temporary installations Our software Through our software partner Korial, operators can plan inspection missions, monitor robots remotely, review inspection results, and gain AI-powered insights from every mission.
